bullets.id: Emas spot turun 0,3% ke $4.161,20 pada Selasa setelah sempat naik ke sekitar $4.187 di awal sesi AS, sementara kontrak berjangka Desember naik 0,2% ke $4.184,30. Dolar bertahan dekat level tertinggi sejak April 2025, sehingga emas tertahan menjelang rilis CPI September AS pada Rabu malam pukul 19.30 WIB. Konsensus memperkirakan inflasi tahunan naik ke sekitar 3,7%, sedangkan inflasi inti diperkirakan melambat.
bullets.en: Spot gold fell 0.3% to $4,161.20 on Tuesday after briefly rising to about $4,187 early in the US session, while December futures rose 0.2% to $4,184.30. The dollar held near its highest level since April 2025, keeping gold in check ahead of the US September CPI release on Wednesday at 19:30 WIB. Consensus sees annual inflation rising to about 3.7%, while core inflation is expected to slow.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun turun 3,9 bp ke 5,209% dan indeks dolar mundur ke sekitar 102,4, tetapi Brent bertahan di atas $104 akibat serangan Houthi ke Arab Saudi. Data kerja September hanya +29.000, tetapi pasar masih memberi peluang sekitar 85% kenaikan suku bunga hingga Desember, dan John Williams (Fed New York) memperkirakan satu kenaikan lagi tahun ini. Emas turun sekitar 3% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield fell 3.9 bp to 5.209% and the dollar index eased to about 102.4, but Brent held above $104 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. September payrolls rose just 29,000, yet markets still price about an 85% chance of a rate hike by December, and New York Fed President John Williams expects one more hike this year. Gold is down about 3% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai resistance di $4.207, lalu zona $4.217–$4.227, $4.273 dan $4.316. Support di $4.181 dan $4.155, lalu $4.110 dan $4.067, dekat titik terendah pekan lalu sekitar $4.066. Setelah CPI, data PPI dan penjualan ritel AS dirilis Kamis.
bullets.en: Kitco marks resistance at $4,207, then the $4,217–$4,227 zone, $4,273 and $4,316. Support sits at $4,181 and $4,155, then $4,110 and $4,067, near last week’s low of about $4,066. After CPI, the US PPI and retail sales data are due on Thursday.

bullets.id: Antam stagnan di Rp2.574.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.383.000, spread Rp191.000 (sekitar 7,4%), setelah turun Rp20.000 pada Selasa. Galeri24 Rp2.521.000 (buyback Rp2.374.000) dan UBS Rp2.546.000 (buyback Rp2.348.000). Permintaan struktural tetap kuat: ETF emas global mencatat arus masuk rekor $31 miliar pada kuartal III, dan bank sentral China membeli emas 23 bulan berturut-turut.
bullets.en: Antam is unchanged at Rp2,574,000/gram with a Rp2,383,000 buyback, a Rp191,000 spread (about 7.4%), after a Rp20,000 drop on Tuesday. Galeri24 is at Rp2,521,000 (buyback Rp2,374,000) and UBS at Rp2,546,000 (buyback Rp2,348,000). Structural demand stays strong: global gold ETFs posted record Q3 inflows of $31 billion, and China’s central bank has bought gold for 23 straight months.
